notes: Chess teacher mode actually teaches now, search is more accurate and time-aware, and when she says she'll check something she actually does it.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.10

sections.title: She follows through now
items: When she says "let me check that", she actually goes and checks, and answers in the same breath. Before, that promise sometimes went nowhere and you had to ask again.

sections.title: Chess
items: Teacher mode explains her thinking on every move instead of staying quiet most of the game, and now suggests your best next move with the reason behind it.
Fewer mix-ups about whose piece is whose.

sections.title: Search
items: She checks how old an article is before telling you something is happening now, so a protest that ended weeks ago is no longer reported as current.
Filtered out junk results that came through as jumbled run-on titles.
Slow pages get a bit longer to load, so answers are based on the full article more often.

sections.title: Awareness
items: She no longer thinks you're still on a page you already left.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
